title: Advanced Mace Craft, First Part
summary: Advances the mace student into combined armor-breaking and shield-breaking work, using full meridian flow in every stroke.

title: Weight Doctrine of the Flanged Mace
summary: Argues that a mace wins by mass and timing, and teaches how to carry that mass through each stroke.

title: Treatise on Crushing the Armored Line
summary: Teaches a mace bearer how to break an armored line, one body at a time, using qi at every blow.

title: Qi-Field Mace Method
summary: Teaches a Xiantian student to extend living qi beyond the body and carry it through the mace as one field.

title: Mace Beyond the Body
summary: Treats the mace and the body as one organ, teaching Xiantian students to swing the head from the dantian.

title: Twin-Weight Mace Canon
summary: Teaches a mace held in two weights, a heavy head and a counterweighted pommel, swung as a pair of strokes.

title: Hawk-Stoop Mace Methods
summary: Teaches the diving overhead strokes of a mace fighter who drops onto a target from a raised guard.

title: Azure Basin Mace Treatise
summary: Teaches a basin-cupped field of qi around the mace head, drawing blows into it and then crushing them.

title: Paired Head River Doctrine
summary: Teaches fighting with paired heads and a flowing river of qi down the haft, for students of the twin-head mace.

title: Wind-Sworn Mace Rolls
summary: Teaches wind-sworn mace fighters to roll the head in continuous circles, never stopping the swing to rest.

title: Plateau Edge Mace Bearings
summary: Teaches how to hold a bearing at a plateau's edge, using the mace to keep a fighter from being pushed back.

title: Gale Oath Mace Book
summary: Teaches Xiantian mace fighters to swear a stroke to the gale and carry its full weight with a field of qi.

title: Bearing Held Mace Treatise
summary: Teaches fighters to take a bearing and hold it against any press, with a field of qi bound to the haft.
